name: Saint Mary-of-the-Woods College
tuition_note: 2026-27 from smwc.edu/offices-resources/offices/financial-aid/tuition-and-fees/. Private college, single published rate: full-time tuition $16,970/semester = $33,940/yr plus general fee $750/semester = $1,500/yr, total tuition & fees $35,440. Housing is room-only, priced by hall/room type ($5,000-$11,600/yr); used the standard/lowest double community-bath room in Le Fer Hall ($5,000/yr). Board (meal plans) listed separately (~$6,800/yr, not included).
